verdict.rationale: Cline does expose programmatic surfaces, including a hosted gateway Chat Completions endpoint and an SDK built on its core engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The probe only shows the gateway defers to OpenAI's format and publishes no spec of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
